comment: Season definitions for the Continuous Model League. Seasons give the never-frozen league narrative shape: 4-week arcs with a champion, a theme, and an archive. Computed against league state — no league-code changes required. `current` governs the page until `next.started_at` passes, then the banner and finale switch over automatically; an ended season's finale is frozen to artifacts/arena/continuous/seasons/<id>.json by the page generator (first computation after ends_at wins). The archive stays hand-managed.

current.name: Genesis
current.theme: Ten walk in. The league learns what it's made of. The first retirements, the first recruits, the first feedback class — every record is a first.
current.champion_rule: Highest L0 (zero-shot) rating at season end; ties broken by win rate, then matches played.

next.name: Ascension
next.theme: The crown has an owner. Genesis wrote the first records; Ascension is the climb to take them — every revision, every recruit, every feedback cycle aimed at the top rung.
next.champion_rule: Highest L0 (zero-shot) rating at season end; ties broken by win rate, then matches played.
